title: Observable Outfitters · Business Impact
description: Shopping activity, dropoff after successful cart addition, product interest and checkout outcomes from Grafana Faro in 1-minute time buckets; product rankings cover the selected range. Dropoff requires no successful checkout and no new recorded session events for the configurable timeout: 60 seconds for the simulator demo or 15 minutes normally. Faro sessions group shopping journeys; browser telemetry is best effort.

list.name: idle_timeout_seconds
list.label: Dropoff timeout
list.description: Required time with no new recorded events for the same Faro session before counting dropoff. Requires a successful add-to-cart and no successful checkout. Demo default 60 seconds allows headroom for simulator navigation, payment waits, and telemetry delivery; choose 15 minutes normally. This is a dashboard rule, not Faro's session expiry.

panels.title: Active Sessions per Minute
panels.description: Distinct Faro sessions with at least one event in each 1-minute bucket. A session can appear in multiple buckets, so do not sum these bars to calculate total sessions. Sessions are not unique people; reloads do not add sessions. Sampling is 100%. Blue indicates activity volume, not a health status.

panels.title: Dropoffs Percentage
panels.description: A session is a dropoff if it has at least one successful add-to-cart, has no successful checkout, and has produced no new recorded session events for the selected Dropoff timeout. For each 1-minute bucket, count qualified sessions whose last recorded event plus that timeout falls within the minute; show dropoffs as a percentage of all such qualified sessions. Browsing-only sessions, failed cart additions, and sessions with more recent events are excluded from both counts. Successful cart additions and checkouts are checked across Faro's maximum four-hour session lifetime. Default 60 seconds for the simulator demo; choose 15 minutes normally. This uses recorded-event silence; there is no separate session-termination condition. Missing or delayed events can cause false classification. No eligible sessions shows no data; all eligible sessions converted shows 0%. Any successful checkout converts the whole Faro session. Visual bands: below 30% green, 30% to below 60% amber (warning), and 60% or more red (high). Dashed lines mark the thresholds. These are illustrative demo thresholds, not agreed SLOs or alert rules; tune them to a measured baseline. Hover the chart to see the rate for a specific minute; gaps remain gaps.

targets.expr:
# Dropoff % = 100 x inactive, unconverted cart sessions / all eligible cart sessions.
# The offset moves the cohort back by the selected idle timeout.
# 4h1m covers the four-hour session history plus the cohort minute.
100 *
(
  # Numerator: eligible sessions without a purchase; 0 if all converted.
  count(
    # Sessions with activity in the minute before the idle window.
    sum by (session_id) (
      count_over_time(
        {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
          | logfmt
          | __error__=""
          | session_id!=""
          [1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s
      )
    )
    # Exclude sessions with any newer activity.
    unless
    sum by (session_id) (
      count_over_time(
        {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
          | logfmt
          | __error__=""
          | session_id!=""
          [${idle_timeout_seconds}s]
      )
    )
    # Require a successful cart addition in the session history.
    and
    sum by (session_id) (
      count_over_time(
        {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
          | logfmt
          | __error__=""
          | session_id!=""
          | event_name="shop.cart_add"
          | event_data_outcome="success"
          [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s
      )
    )
    # Exclude sessions with a successful checkout.
    unless
    sum by (session_id) (
      count_over_time(
        {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
          | logfmt
          | __error__=""
          | session_id!=""
          | event_name="shop.checkout"
          | event_data_outcome="success"
          [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s
      )
    )
  )
  or vector(0)
)
/
# Denominator: all eligible sessions. An empty cohort stays no data.
count(
  # Sessions with activity in the minute before the idle window.
  sum by (session_id) (
    count_over_time(
      {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
        | logfmt
        | __error__=""
        | session_id!=""
        [1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s
    )
  )
  # Exclude sessions with any newer activity.
  unless
  sum by (session_id) (
    count_over_time(
      {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
        | logfmt
        | __error__=""
        | session_id!=""
        [${idle_timeout_seconds}s]
    )
  )
  # Require a successful cart addition in the session history.
  and
  sum by (session_id) (
    count_over_time(
      {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
        | logfmt
        | __error__=""
        | session_id!=""
        | event_name="shop.cart_add"
        | event_data_outcome="success"
        [4h1m] offset ${idle_timeout_seconds}s
    )
  )
)

panels.title: Views by Product
panels.description: Product page views in the selected range; repeat visits count again. Horizontal bars rank products by views. Blue indicates activity volume, not a health status.

panels.title: Checkouts
panels.description: Completed checkout attempts per 1-minute bucket, stacked by success/fail. Every retry is a separate attempt; validation and payment failures are included. Pending attempts appear when they finish. Successful attempts are green; failed attempts are red. Labels identify outcomes without relying on color.

panels.title: Checkouts by Product
panels.description: Units purchased per product in the selected range, summed only after a successful checkout response. Declines and out-of-stock attempts contribute no units. Browser-observed purchases are not an accounting ledger. Green indicates units from successful purchases.

targets.expr:
# Sum purchased units per product over the selected dashboard range.
sum by (event_data_product_id) (
  sum_over_time(
    {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
      | logfmt
      | event_name="shop.product_purchased"
      | unwrap event_data_quantity
      | __error__=""
      [$__range]
  )
)

panels.title: Checkout Error Rate
panels.description: For each 1-minute bucket: failed checkout attempts / all completed attempts × 100. Retries count separately. No attempts shows no data; successful attempts with no failures show 0%. Visual bands: below 5% green, 5% to below 10% amber (warning), and 10% or more red (high). Dashed lines mark the thresholds. These are illustrative demo thresholds, not agreed SLOs or alert rules; tune them to a measured baseline. Hover the chart to see the rate for a specific minute; gaps remain gaps.

targets.expr:
# Checkout error % = 100 x failed attempts / all completed attempts per minute.
100 *
(
  # No failures counts as 0 when there are completed attempts.
  sum(
    count_over_time(
      {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
        | logfmt
        | event_name="shop.checkout"
        | event_data_outcome="fail"
        [1m]
    )
  )
  or vector(0)
)
/
# No completed attempts leaves a gap.
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {service_name="observable-outfitters", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"}
      | logfmt
      | event_name="shop.checkout"
      [1m]
  )
)
